verses.en: And David spake unto the LORD the words of this song in the day that the LORD had delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul:
verses.pt: E falou Davi ao SENHOR as palavras deste cântico, o dia que o SENHOR o livrou da mão de todos os seus inimigos e da mão de Saul.
verses.en_web: David spoke to Yahweh the words of this song in the day that Yahweh delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul,
verses.en_bbe: And David made a song to the Lord in these words, on the day when the Lord made him free from the hands of all his haters, and from the hand of Saul:

verses.en: And he said, The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer;
verses.pt: E disse: O SENHOR é minha rocha, e minha fortaleza, e meu libertador;
verses.en_web: and he said: “Yahweh is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer, even mine;
verses.en_bbe: And he said, The Lord is my Rock, my walled town, and my saviour, even mine;

verses.en: The God of my rock; in him will I trust: he is my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge, my saviour; thou savest me from violence.
verses.pt: Deus de minha rocha, nele confiarei: Meu escudo, e o poder de minha salvação, minha fortaleza, e meu refúgio; Meu salvador, que me livrarás de violência.
verses.en_web: God is my rock in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge. My savior, you save me from violence.
verses.en_bbe: My God, my Rock, in him will I put my faith; my breastplate, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my safe place; my saviour, who keeps me safe from the violent man.

verses.en: I will call on the LORD, who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.
verses.pt: Invocarei ao SENHOR, digno de ser louvado. E serei salvo de meus inimigos.
verses.en_web: I call on Yahweh, who is worthy to be praised; So shall I be saved from my enemies.
verses.en_bbe: I will send up my cry to the Lord, who is to be praised; so will I be made safe from those who are against me.

verses.en: When the waves of death compassed me, the floods of ungodly men made me afraid;
verses.pt: Quando me cercaram ondas de morte, E ribeiros de iniquidade me assombraram,
verses.en_web: For the waves of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.
verses.en_bbe: For the waves of death came round me, and the seas of evil put me in fear;

verses.en: The sorrows of hell compassed me about; the snares of death prevented me;
verses.pt: As cordas do Xeol me rodearam, e laços de morte me tomaram desprevenido.
verses.en_web: The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death caught me.
verses.en_bbe: The cords of hell were round me: the nets of death came on me.

verses.en: In my distress I called upon the LORD, and cried to my God: and he did hear my voice out of his temple, and my cry did enter into his ears.
verses.pt: Tive angústia, invoquei ao SENHOR, E clamei a meu Deus: E ele ouviu minha voz desde seu templo; Chegou meu clamor a seus ouvidos.
verses.en_web: In my distress, I called on Yahweh. Yes, I called to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry came into his ears.
verses.en_bbe: In my trouble my voice went up to the Lord, and my cry to my God: my voice came to his hearing in his holy Temple, and my prayer came to his ears.

verses.en: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations of heaven moved and shook, because he was wroth.
verses.pt: A terra se moveu, e tremeu; Os fundamentos dos céus foram movidos, E se estremeceram, porque ele se irou.
verses.en_web: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations of heaven quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.
verses.en_bbe: Then the earth was moved with a violent shock; the bases of heaven were moved and shaking, because he was angry.

verses.en: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.
verses.pt: Subiu fumaça de suas narinas, E de sua boca fogo consumidor, Pelo qual se acenderam carvões.
verses.en_web: Smoke went up out of his nostrils. Consuming fire came out of his mouth. Coals were kindled by it.
verses.en_bbe: There went up a smoke from his nose, and a fire of destruction from his mouth: coals were lighted by it.

verses.en: He bowed the heavens also, and came down; and darkness was under his feet.
verses.pt: E abaixo os céus, e desceu: Uma escuridão debaixo de seus pés.
verses.en_web: He bowed the heavens also, and came down. Thick darkness was under his feet.
verses.en_bbe: The heavens were bent, so that he might come down; and it was dark under his feet.

verses.en: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: and he was seen upon the wings of the wind.
verses.pt: Subiu sobre o querubim, e voou: Apareceu-se sobre as asas do vento.
verses.en_web: He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he was seen on the wings of the wind.
verses.en_bbe: And he went through the air, seated on a storm-cloud: going quickly on the wings of the wind.

verses.en: And he made darkness pavilions round about him, dark waters, and thick clouds of the skies.
verses.pt: Armou tendas de escuridão ao redor de si; nuvens negras e espessas, carregadas de águas.
verses.en_web: He made darkness a shelter around himself: gathering of waters, and thick clouds of the skies.
verses.en_bbe: And he made the dark his tent round him, a mass of waters, thick clouds of the skies.

verses.en: Through the brightness before him were coals of fire kindled.
verses.pt: Do resplendor de sua presença Se acenderam brasas ardentes.
verses.en_web: At the brightness before him, coals of fire were kindled.
verses.en_bbe: Before his shining light his dark clouds went past, raining ice and coals of fire.

verses.en: The LORD thundered from heaven, and the most High uttered his voice.
verses.pt: O SENHOR trovejou desde os céus, E o Altíssimo deu sua voz;
verses.en_web: Yahweh thundered from heaven. The Most High uttered his voice.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord made thunder in the heavens, and the voice of the Highest was sounding out.

verses.en: And he sent out arrows, and scattered them; lightning, and discomfited them.
verses.pt: Lançou flechas, e desbaratou-os; Relampejou, e consumiu-os.
verses.en_web: He sent out arrows, and scattered them; lightning, and confused them.
verses.en_bbe: And he sent out his arrows, driving them in all directions; by his flames of fire they were troubled.

verses.en: And the channels of the sea appeared, the foundations of the world were discovered, at the rebuking of the LORD, at the blast of the breath of his nostrils.
verses.pt: Então apareceram as profundezas do mar, E os fundamentos do mundo foram descobertos, À repreensão do SENHOR, Ao sopro do vento de seu nariz.
verses.en_web: Then the channels of the sea appeared. The foundations of the world were laid bare by Yahweh’s rebuke, at the blast of the breath of his nostrils.
verses.en_bbe: Then the deep beds of the sea were seen, and the bases of the world were uncovered, because of the Lord's wrath, because of the breath of his mouth.

verses.en: He sent from above, he took me; he drew me out of many waters;
verses.pt: Estendeu sua mão do alto, e arrebatou-me, E tirou-me de copiosas águas.
verses.en_web: He sent from on high and he took me. He drew me out of many waters.
verses.en_bbe: He sent from on high, he took me, pulling me out of great waters.

verses.en: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them that hated me: for they were too strong for me.
verses.pt: Livrou-me de fortes inimigos, De aqueles que me aborreciam, os quais eram mais fortes que eu.
verses.en_web: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me, for they were too mighty for me.
verses.en_bbe: He made me free from my strong hater, from those who were against me, because they were stronger than I.

verses.en: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the LORD was my stay.
verses.pt: Atacaram-me no dia de minha calamidade; Mas o SENHOR foi meu apoio.
verses.en_web: They came on me in the day of my calamity, but Yahweh was my support.
verses.en_bbe: They came on me in the day of my trouble: but the Lord was my support.

verses.en: He brought me forth also into a large place: he delivered me, because he delighted in me.
verses.pt: Tirou-me para um lugar amplo; Livrou-me, porque se agradou de mim.
verses.en_web: He also brought me out into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me.
verses.en_bbe: He took me out into a wide place; he was my saviour because he had delight in me.

verses.en: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness: according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.
verses.pt: Remunerou-me o SENHOR conforme minha justiça: E conforme a limpeza de minhas mãos ele me pagou.
verses.en_web: Yahweh rewarded me according to my righteousness. He rewarded me according to the cleanness of my hands.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord gives me the reward of my righteousness, because my hands are clean before him.

verses.en: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
verses.pt: Porque eu guardei os caminhos do SENHOR; E não me apartei impiamente de meu Deus.
verses.en_web: For I have kept Yahweh’s ways, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
verses.en_bbe: For I have kept the ways of the Lord; I have not been turned away in sin from my God.

verses.en: For all his judgments were before me: and as for his statutes, I did not depart from them.
verses.pt: Porque diante de mim tenho todas suas ordenanças; E atento a seus estatutos, não me retirarei deles.
verses.en_web: For all his ordinances were before me. As for his statutes, I did not depart from them.
verses.en_bbe: For all his decisions were before me, and I did not put away his laws from me.

verses.en: I was also upright before him, and have kept myself from mine iniquity.
verses.pt: E fui íntegro para com ele, E guardei-me de minha iniquidade.
verses.en_web: I was also perfect toward him. I kept myself from my iniquity.
verses.en_bbe: And I was upright before him, and I kept myself from sin.

verses.en: Therefore the LORD hath recompensed me according to my righteousness; according to my cleanness in his eye sight.
verses.pt: Remunerou-me, portanto, o SENHOR conforme minha justiça, E conforme minha limpeza diante de seus olhos.
verses.en_web: Therefore Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness, According to my cleanness in his eyesight.
verses.en_bbe: Because of this the Lord has given me the reward of my righteousness, because my hands are clean in his eyes.

verses.en: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful, and with the upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright.
verses.pt: Com o bom és benigno, E com o íntegro te mostras íntegro;
verses.en_web: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful. With the perfect man you will show yourself perfect.
verses.en_bbe: On him who has mercy you will have mercy; to the upright you will be upright;

verses.en: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself unsavoury.
verses.pt: Limpo és para com o limpo, Mas com o perverso és rígido.
verses.en_web: With the pure you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.
verses.en_bbe: He who is holy will see that you are holy; but to the man whose way is not straight you will be a hard judge.

verses.en: And the afflicted people thou wilt save: but thine eyes are upon the haughty, that thou mayest bring them down.
verses.pt: E tu salvas ao povo humilde; Mas teus olhos sobre os altivos, para abatê-los.
verses.en_web: You will save the afflicted people, But your eyes are on the haughty, that you may bring them down.
verses.en_bbe: For you are the saviour of those who are in trouble; but your eyes are on men of pride, to make them low.

verses.en: For thou art my lamp, O LORD: and the LORD will lighten my darkness.
verses.pt: Porque tu és minha lâmpada, ó SENHOR; o SENHOR dá luz às minhas trevas.
verses.en_web: For you are my lamp, Yahweh. Yahweh will light up my darkness.
verses.en_bbe: For you are my light, O Lord; and the Lord will make the dark bright for me.

verses.en: For by thee I have run through a troop: by my God have I leaped over a wall.
verses.pt: Pois contigo avançarei contra uma tropa, e com o meu Deus saltarei uma muralha.
verses.en_web: For by you, I run against a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall.
verses.en_bbe: By your help I have made a way through the wall which was shutting me in: by the help of my God I have gone over a wall.

verses.en: As for God, his way is perfect; the word of the LORD is tried: he is a buckler to all them that trust in him.
verses.pt: O caminho de Deus é perfeito; a palavra do SENHOR é purificada, é escudo é de todos os que nele confiam.
verses.en_web: As for God, his way is perfect. Yahweh’s word is tested. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.
verses.en_bbe: As for God, his way is all good: the word of the Lord is tested; he is a safe cover for all those who put their faith in him.

verses.en: For who is God, save the LORD? and who is a rock, save our God?
verses.pt: Porque que Deus há a não ser o SENHOR? Ou quem é forte a não ser nosso Deus?
verses.en_web: For who is God, besides Yahweh? Who is a rock, besides our God?
verses.en_bbe: For who is God but the Lord? and who is a Rock but our God?

verses.en: God is my strength and power: and he maketh my way perfect.
verses.pt: Deus é o que com virtude me corrobora, e o que tira os obstáculos do meu caminho;
verses.en_web: God is my strong fortress. He makes my way perfect.
verses.en_bbe: God puts a strong band about me, guiding me in a straight way.

verses.en: He maketh my feet like hinds feet: and setteth me upon my high places.
verses.pt: O que faz meus pés como de cervas, E o que me assenta em minhas alturas;
verses.en_web: He makes his feet like hinds’ feet, and sets me on my high places.
verses.en_bbe: He makes my feet like roes' feet, and puts me on high places.

verses.en: He teacheth my hands to war; so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.
verses.pt: O que ensina minhas mãos para a luta, e proporciona que com meus braços quebre o arco de bronze.
verses.en_web: He teaches my hands to war, so that my arms bend a bow of brass.
verses.en_bbe: He makes my hands expert in war, so that a bow of brass is bent by my arms.

verses.en: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy gentleness hath made me great.
verses.pt: Tu me deste também o escudo de tua salvação, E tua benignidade me acrescentou.
verses.en_web: You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your gentleness has made me great.
verses.en_bbe: You have given me the breastplate of your salvation, and your mercy has made me great.

verses.en: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me; so that my feet did not slip.
verses.pt: Tu alargaste meus desfiladeiros debaixo de mim, Para que não titubeassem meus joelhos.
verses.en_web: You have enlarged my steps under me. My feet have not slipped.
verses.en_bbe: You have made my steps wide under me, so that my feet make no slip.

verses.en: I have pursued mine enemies, and destroyed them; and turned not again until I had consumed them.
verses.pt: Perseguirei a meus inimigos, e os quebrantarei; E não me voltarei até que os acabe.
verses.en_web: I have pursued my enemies and destroyed them. I didn’t turn again until they were consumed.
verses.en_bbe: I go after my haters and overtake them; not turning back till they are all overcome.

verses.en: And I have consumed them, and wounded them, that they could not arise: yea, they are fallen under my feet.
verses.pt: Os consumirei, e os ferirei, e não se levantarão; E cairão debaixo de meus pés.
verses.en_web: I have consumed them, and struck them through, so that they can’t arise. Yes, they have fallen under my feet.
verses.en_bbe: I have sent destruction on them and given them wounds, so that they are not able to get up: they are stretched under my feet.

verses.en: For thou hast girded me with strength to battle: them that rose up against me hast thou subdued under me.
verses.pt: Cingiste-me de força para a batalha, E fizeste prostrar debaixo de mim os que contra mim se levantaram.
verses.en_web: For you have armed me with strength for the battle. You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.
verses.en_bbe: For I have been armed by you with strength for the fight: you have made low under me those who came out against me.

verses.en: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies, that I might destroy them that hate me.
verses.pt: Tu me deste o pescoço de meus inimigos, De meus aborrecedores, que eu os destruísse.
verses.en_web: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.
verses.en_bbe: By you their backs are turned in flight, so that my haters are cut off.

verses.en: They looked, but there was none to save; even unto the LORD, but he answered them not.
verses.pt: Olharam, e não houve quem os livrasse; Ao SENHOR, mas não lhes respondeu.
verses.en_web: They looked, but there was no one to save; even to Yahweh, but he didn’t answer them.
verses.en_bbe: They were crying out, but there was no one to come to their help: even to the Lord, but he gave them no answer.

verses.en: Then did I beat them as small as the dust of the earth, I did stamp them as the mire of the street, and did spread them abroad.
verses.pt: Eu os esmiuçarei como pó da terra; Eu os pisarei como à lama das ruas, e os dissiparei.
verses.en_web: Then I beat them as small as the dust of the earth. I crushed them as the mire of the streets, and spread them abroad.
verses.en_bbe: Then they were crushed as small as the dust of the earth, stamped down under my feet like the waste of the streets.

verses.en: Thou also hast delivered me from the strivings of my people, thou hast kept me to be head of the heathen: a people which I knew not shall serve me.
verses.pt: Tu me livraste das brigas dos povos; Tu me guardaste para eu que fosse cabeça de nações: Povos que eu não conhecia me serviram.
verses.en_web: You also have delivered me from the strivings of my people. You have kept me to be the head of the nations. A people whom I have not known will serve me.
verses.en_bbe: You have made me free from the fightings of my people; you have made me the head of the nations: a people of whom I had no knowledge will be my servants.

verses.en: Strangers shall submit themselves unto me: as soon as they hear, they shall be obedient unto me.
verses.pt: Os estrangeiros se sujeitaram a mim; ao ouvirem, me obedeciam.
verses.en_web: The foreigners will submit themselves to me. As soon as they hear of me, they will obey me.
verses.en_bbe: Men of other countries will, with false hearts, put themselves under my authority: from the time when my name comes to their ears, they will be ruled by me.

verses.en: Strangers shall fade away, and they shall be afraid out of their close places.
verses.pt: Os estrangeiros desfaleciam, E tremiam em seus esconderijos.
verses.en_web: The foreigners will fade away, and will come trembling out of their close places.
verses.en_bbe: They will be wasted away, they will come out of their secret places shaking with fear.

verses.en: The LORD liveth; and blessed be my rock; and exalted be the God of the rock of my salvation.
verses.pt: Viva o SENHOR, e seja bendita minha rocha; Seja exaltado o Deus, a rocha de meu salvamento:
verses.en_web: Yahweh lives! Blessed be my rock! Exalted be God, the rock of my salvation,
verses.en_bbe: The Lord is living; praise be to my Rock, and let the God of my salvation be honoured:

verses.en: It is God that avengeth me, and that bringeth down the people under me,
verses.pt: O Deus que me vingou, E sujeita os povos debaixo de mim:
verses.en_web: even the God who executes vengeance for me, who brings down peoples under me,
verses.en_bbe: It is God who sends punishment on my haters, and puts peoples under my rule.

verses.en: And that bringeth me forth from mine enemies: thou also hast lifted me up on high above them that rose up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.
verses.pt: E que me tira dentre meus inimigos: Tu me tiraste em alto dentre os que se levantaram contra mim: Livraste-me do homem de iniquidades.
verses.en_web: who brings me away from my enemies. Yes, you lift me up above those who rise up against me. You deliver me from the violent man.
verses.en_bbe: He makes me free from my haters: I am lifted up over those who come up against me: you have made me free from the violent man.

verses.en: Therefore I will give thanks unto thee, O LORD, among the heathen, and I will sing praises unto thy name.
verses.pt: Portanto eu te confessarei entre as nações, ó SENHOR, E cantarei a teu nome.
verses.en_web: Therefore I will give thanks to you, Yahweh, among the nations, and will sing praises to your name.
verses.en_bbe: Because of this I will give you praise, O Lord, among the nations, and will make a song of praise to your name.

verses.en: He is the tower of salvation for his king: and sheweth mercy to his anointed, unto David, and to his seed for evermore.
verses.pt: Ele que engrandece as saúdes de seu rei, E faz misericórdia a seu ungido, A Davi, e à sua semente, para sempre.
verses.en_web: He gives great deliverance to his king, and shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his offspring, forever more.”
verses.en_bbe: Great salvation does he give to his king; he has mercy on the king of his selection, David, and on his seed for ever.
